sheets.title: What a duress-code unlock shows, on Settings › Security — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A password vault is sealed, the duress code is turned on, the vault is locked, and the duress code is typed at the password prompt. Same journey on both builds. The base build puts an unstyled status banner over the page and labels the session guest@guest; the branch shows the page an ordinary unlock shows, under the vault's own label.
sheets.before: status banner 'Unavailable (missing_decoy) Vault locked'; label guest@guest; page says 'You are a guest...'
sheets.after: no banner (0 overlay elements); label guest@personal, as a real unlock; no guest copy
